notes.title: Small update!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

We just have uploaded a small update of Let's go Nuts! 

Also, we've got news for you: Dirt Bike Insanity will be available to purchase on Steam Store, 15th June!!!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/851940/Dirt_Bike_Insanity/

and we have a brand new game available to check on Steam Store, add to your wishlist, if you like it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/879120/ClusterDisaster/

Enjoy!

notes.title: Let's Go Nuts - Update!
notes.content:

祝你有美好的一天, tenha um bom dia!
